description: No mechanism to encrypt and decrypt ePHI.
applicability: This signal applies to: Electronic health record (EHR) systems Health information exchanges (HIEs) Patient portals and healthcare applications Database systems containing ePHI Network infrastructure transmitting ePHI Cloud services hosting healthcare data

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Examine data storage configurations, database encryption settings, and file system encryption status. Check for unencrypted ePHI at rest on servers, workstations, portable devices, and backup media. Verify encryption standards and key management practices for systems that do implement encryption.
